cards.name: Tidal Wave
cards.text: Choose a direction. Relocate all fighters that are in your Back Row 1 square in that direction.

abilities.text: Play this card in your Back Row. During your turn, squares adjacent to your Back Row are considered your Back Row. (This is not repeated for squares that are considered your Back Row by this effect.)

abilities.name: Usherance
abilities.text: During your turn, after a fighter enters a square adjacent to this fighter, you may relocate that fighter 1 square.

abilities.name: Lash Out
abilities.text: After this fighter Moves or is relocated, destroy target adjacent X, where X is the number of squares this fighter has Moved or been relocated out of this turn.

abilities.name: Tidebringer
abilities.text: All squares not in an opponent's Back Row are considered your Back Row. This fighter cannot Move or be relocated out of your Back Row.

cards.name: Aria of Aggression
cards.text: Song: Fatigue any number of Is you control, they are considered Singing until the end of your turn. Target enemy X Attacks target adjacent friendly fighter, where X is equal to or less than the number of friendly Singing fighters.

cards.name: Coercive Cantata
cards.text: Song: Fatigue any number of Is you control, they are considered Singing until the end of your turn. Relocate target enemy fighter X to an unoccupied square that is X squares away, where X is equal to or less than the number of friendly Singing fighters.

abilities.name: Depth Charge
abilities.text: Destroy target enemy I or II in your Back Row that is not in an opponent's Gates. Relocate this fighter to that square if it is now unoccupied.

abilities.name: Bards-for-Hire
abilities.text: Replace the abilities of enemy fighters 2 or less squares away with "Entranced: This ability does nothing." Enemy Bards-for-Hire ignore this ability. (They play along instead.)
